headline: PROP dominates activity as AKS last trading day pre-delisting and ANAN posts a 35.7σ volume spike
market_take: Coverage was uneven with sharp downside in small PROP (PF -20.00%, PRECHA -10.34%, CGD -10.00%) and CONS names (PLE -16.67%), offset by speculative bid in ANAN, STELLA, RABBIT, and OSP. Liquidity is concentrated in a handful of names: ANAN ran vol×11.36 on a 35.7σ alert, while OSP, STPI, STELLA, and BTG also printed >4σ volume surges. Governance risk is elevated, with TPOLY's Section 57 default filing and the AKS delisting sequence leading the news flow.

sector_notes.note: T's desk is the busiest: AKS is in its final session pre-delisting with multiple high-sign filings, while ANAN (+13.79%, 35.7σ), STELLA (+8.70%, 8.7σ), RABBIT (+6.67%), and RML (price gap +12.50% then -11.11% intraday) printed extreme moves; NVD (G) filed a connected-transaction asset disposal.
TRITN (K) is the standout with a -33.33% open gap that reversed to a +50.00% intraday swing, and TPOLY (G) filed a Section 57 debenture default the same day it opened -10.00% and closed +11.11%.
P's names split: OSP +6.06% with a 6.7σ volume spike and a director resignation filing; F&D -12.43% with a 4.2σ alert; BTG logged a 4.7σ spike alongside its M&A acquisition disclosure.
DCON (O) fell -6.25% on extremely thin volume (vol×0.02) and the earlier Prinsiri connected-transaction clarification remains the most recent high-sign item on file.
Light flow: TPRIME (O) gapped +6.37% on an open-gap alert, and ALLY (C) filed completion of additional investments in The Zone Town in Town.
